main_text.p: tùm curare, & indigné ferre, si quod iá u-sui esse poterat, differatur. Iuxta distichó:

ὠκέαι χαρίτες γλυνκόπικρον ἀλί βραδυλύωι
πᾶσαι χαρίτες ὑμνῖν, μὴ δὲ λέγοιτο χαρίς.
Atqui præstabat meditari aureum illud Salomonis apophthegma: Omni rei est determinatum tempus, & tempus est omni uoluntati sub cœlo. Eccles. 3.1.
main_text.head: Ansit?
main_text.p: Moram aliquando interuenire in dispensatione operum Dei, extra controuersiam esse debet. Est enim Deus agens uoluntarium. Itaque pro infinita sua sapientia, potentia, iusticia & bonitate, aliàs accelerat opera sua, aliàs differt, si, inquam, humanum spectes iudicium: nam si cõsideres Deum, is uerò omnia in tempore facit. Ac uniuersalis experientia omnium piorum, ita rem habere testatur. Iofephi à fratribus uéditi liberatio & exaltatio, totos 13. annos dilata fuit, usque ad tempus, quo uenit uerbum eius, & ser mo Iehouæ probaret eum. Psal. 105.19. Et quàm multi nostrûm, diu rebus aduersis agitati, tandem Deo nos respiciente, & in portum è tempestuoso mari deducente, experti sumus, præcipuo nostro bono dilatam

page.notes: Catchword "latam" appears at the lower right and is repeated at the end of the last line; it has been transcribed only as the last word of the text. The Greek distich is set in Greek letters; accents and breathings are reproduced as far as legible and may contain minor errors. Several letters in the Greek line are blurred. "Ansit?" is a short centred italic heading and is treated as a level-3 heading. The Latin text has some faint marks at the left edge; these are show-through and were not transcribed.
